Author: Ice, bongo
Name: Gather & Chill (fork)
Punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
Description:
A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.

Fork additions:
+ Repair at a mender during a run, keeping your gear above a durability threshold
+ Gather items you've never collected before, so their gathering log entries get filled
